title: Riesz sequences near the critical density
summary: We construct Riesz sequences whose Beurling density is arbitrary close to the critical density in the setting of reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces on metric measure spaces. In particular, our results apply to exponential systems on unbounded sets, nonlocalized Gabor systems and general coherent systems arising from nilpotent Lie groups. The methods used in this paper are based on our previous work on the redundancy of frames and a selector form of Weaver's conjecture.
